name: Mizunose Kotori
source:
Likes: Killing time
Dislikes: Things that she can't use to kill time

A girl in [url=/c17995]Hinata’s[/url] class whom Hinata immediately recognizes as a fellow Elfin. She’s part of the student council which somewhat allows to Hinata to become her friend. Not much is known about her including whether or not she belongs to an organization like [url=/c24584]Riku[/url], [url=/c17038]Rinne[/url], and Hinata do.
